instructions: When recurring failures indicate a harness weakness and an evaluator is configured, invoke {"action":"self_harness"} to propose and evaluate an improvement. The operator configures the fixed validator with /self-harness --scores -- python3 -B -S evaluator.py; /self-harness status shows paths. Proposals are gated by held-in/held-out scores and cannot modify the evaluator. Promotion takes effect after the current turn finishes; use done before relying on new behavior. Report measured results and limitations, not an assumed improvement.
